string.value: We left with few things to do. As soon as the alien spaceship will reach the hit point, we'll launch the missiles and the invasion will be over.
Your mission is to neutralize Pappers. Be extremely careful, we know he has some neurostimulator packs in disposal.
We don't know what this drug does, but the professor developed it together with the Z-120 virus, and he came back for it to the place there the MPs arrested him.
We presume he finds this neurostimulator very important, because his return was a high risk.
Destroy Pappers as soon as possible, he is more dangerous then a tank division even without his drug; what happens if he uses the neurostimulator is beyond my imagination.
Pappers have shown he has some supernatural skills. Be extremely careful and attack first.
You need to chase down professor Pappers. Do not waste a second.
According to the data from the beacon wired in the vehicle Pappers stole, he's nearby. Be careful.
You must destroy the professor, or this thing he became, before he turns into something you can't destroy at all.
Oh, it's you again, agent! You don't get a clue at all, do you? I already gave you a number of chances to die as a hero, yes I did.
But you think you can stand in the way of the progress I represent, yes you do.
You are just a sneaky harmful person, yes you are. So I have to destroy you.
You can be proud to be removed from the Earth by Pappers the Great himself.
However, you may as well kill yourself, yes you do. You have a couple of minutes before I finish my neurostimulation session.
Kill this monster while you still can.
Congratulations, agent! Thanks to your efforts, the Earth is safe.
We launched the missiles five minutes ago, and now they are only a few miles away from the alien mothership.
You brainless critters. You deficient failure! You have no idea what you're doing!! It was our key to the highest state of…
